displayNetwork.title: Display & Network
displayNetwork.subtitle: Sarintany'COLOC is designed to work even on slow or unstable connections, anywhere in Madagascar.
displayNetwork.lightModeDesc: Loads lighter images and limits animations. {{boldActivated}} on 3G+/4G networks or offline; you can also force it here.
displayNetwork.offlineAvailabilityDesc: Saves recently viewed listings and conversations so you can access them without connection.
displayNetwork.installAppDesc: Add Sarintany'COLOC to your home screen without going through an app store.

installModal.intro: Add Sarintany'COLOC to the home screen of your phone or computer to open it like an app.
installModal.android: Android (Chrome): ⋮ menu, then “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
installModal.ios: iPhone (Safari): Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
installModal.desktop: Computer (Chrome / Edge): install icon on the right of the address bar.
installModal.alreadyInstalled: The app is already installed on this device.
installModal.dismissed: Installation cancelled. You can start it again at any time.

notifications.title: Notification Preferences
notifications.subtitle: Choose how you would like to be notified.
notifications.smsInfo: SMS option will be available after the official launch.
